intro.1: TachoMobile uses several sources of information to automatically detect driving.
intro.2: The phone's GPS provides information about the vehicle's movement and speed. Google Activity Recognition helps determine whether the phone is inside or outside the vehicle.
intro.3: These sources are analyzed together to determine the current state of the phone and control automatic driving detection appropriately.

how.title: How does driving detection work?
how.content:
TachoMobile has no direct connection to a tachograph. It uses the phone's GPS and Google Activity Recognition to automatically detect driving activity.

The phone's GPS provides information about the vehicle's movement and speed. Google Activity Recognition helps determine whether the phone is inside or outside the vehicle.

These sources are analyzed together to determine the current state of the phone and control automatic driving detection appropriately.

workModes.title: ⚙️ Detection operating modes
workModes.content:
These are the four operating modes of detection:

⛔ OFF — disabled

Automatic driving detection is completely disabled.

  • GPS is not used for detection.
  • Google Activity Recognition is not used for detection.
  • Activities are entered manually only.

OFF means completely manual activity management.

✋ MANUAL — manual

Activities are entered manually only.

During the following activities, GPS is used to track the route and count kilometres:

  • Driving
  • Availability in a crew

Important: MANUAL does not mean that GPS is completely disabled. GPS works when it is needed to track Driving or Availability in a crew.

STANDBY — standby

Standby is a special mode intended mainly for situations in which the driver is taking a break. In unusual conditions, such as a poor or unstable GPS signal, the application may detect driving even though the vehicle is stationary.

  1. The application may detect possible driving.
  2. A message informs you that driving was detected.
  3. The application waits 30 seconds for confirmation.
  4. If driving is not confirmed, the detection is cancelled.
  5. If driving is confirmed, the driving entry is kept.
  6. The operating mode changes to AUTO.

Standby is recommended during a break.

AUTO — automatic

AUTO is the full automatic driving detection mode.

  • Driver activities are changed automatically based on the algorithm.
  • GPS works during work.
  • Automatic detection works during work.

After work ends and the driver card is removed, automatic driving detection is suspended.

During rest after work ends, GPS is not used for automatic driving detection.

vehicleStates.title: Vehicle recognition states
vehicleStates.content:
TachoMobile shows the current recognition state with an icon in Application Status.

Important: The vehicle recognition state is not the same as the driver's activity. It is one of the elements used by the detection engine when deciding whether to change the activity.

⏸️ Definitely outside the vehicle

The application is highly confident that the phone is outside the vehicle. In battery-saving modes GPS may be used very rarely in this state — even one sample every 60 seconds.

Outside the vehicle

The phone has been recognized as being outside the vehicle.

Definitely in the vehicle

The application is highly confident that the phone is inside the vehicle. A lower driving activation speed threshold may be used in this state.

In the vehicle

The application has recognized that the phone is inside the vehicle.

In-Car Lock

In-Car Lock is not a setting available to the user. It is an automatic mechanism that protects detection operation.

If the application is highly confident that the phone is in the vehicle and it is connected to a charger, it may activate In-Car Lock.

In this state the application assumes that the phone remains in the vehicle and does not switch to other recognition states because of short or temporary signal changes.

In-Car Lock is released after:

  • the charger is disconnected,
  • or a stop lasting at least 2 minutes is detected.

The lowest driving activation speed threshold is used in In-Car Lock.

In-Car Lock is automatic. The user does not turn it on manually.

power.title: Switch to rest after power loss
power.content:
This is an option available in the driving detection settings.

When enabled, after stopping or at a very low speed, loss of power may automatically switch the activity to rest.

For example:

driving → stopping → ignition switched off → rest

This function is separate from In-Car Lock.

detectionModes.title: Detection modes
detectionModes.content:
This is a separate setting from the four operating modes: OFF / MANUAL / STANDBY / AUTO.

⛔ Disabled

Automatic GPS sampling for detection is disabled.

High accuracy

  • Fast GPS sampling.
  • Fast detection response.
  • Fast sampling also during a detected stop.
  • High accuracy and responsiveness.
  • Increased battery consumption.

⚖️ Balanced

  • A compromise between speed and battery consumption.
  • After a stop is detected, batched sampling is used.
  • This is the default mode.

Battery saving

This is an economical mode recommended for everyday work.

  • After a stop is detected, GPS is used very rarely: one sample every 60 seconds.
  • Above 50 km/h, sampling is batched every 8 seconds.

Battery saving still allows automatic driving detection. It mainly changes how GPS is used.

High accuracy, Balanced and Battery saving are default detection modes, and each of them has its own driving activation and deactivation speeds.

custom.title: Custom mode
custom.content:
Custom mode is a Premium feature. It lets the user adapt detection to their own needs.

This section also contains the user's adjustable driving activation and deactivation speeds and the tracking mode used while stopped.

Sampling sensitivity

This determines the number of GPS samples used to calculate an average.

Default value: 3 samples.

Interval between samples

This determines the time between consecutive GPS samples.

Default value: 4 seconds.

The default configuration means 3 samples taken every 4 seconds. An average is calculated from these samples and then used by the algorithm when determining driving activation and deactivation speed.

thresholds.title: Activation and deactivation speeds
thresholds.content:
In Custom mode, the user can adjust speed thresholds.

The algorithm uses vehicle recognition information together with the average GPS speed.

Default recognition levels:

  • Definitely in the vehicle — 3 km/h
  • Probably in the vehicle — 6 km/h
  • Probably outside the vehicle — 12 km/h
  • Outside the vehicle — 15 km/h

These values are not a simple “above X km/h = driving” system. They are parameters used by the algorithm together with the vehicle recognition state.

The default detection modes also have their own activation and deactivation speeds. Custom mode allows the user to adjust these thresholds.

stoppedTracking.title: Tracking mode during a stop
stoppedTracking.content:
After a stop is detected, the user can choose how GPS tracking should continue.

Real time

GPS samples are taken according to the configured scheme. For example, with a 4-second interval, samples are taken every 4 seconds. This corresponds to High accuracy.

Batching

Samples are grouped into larger intervals. For example: 16 seconds. This corresponds to Balanced.

Eco

GPS is used much less often. For example: 60 seconds. This corresponds to Battery saving.

This is a way to reduce battery consumption while stopped.

switching.title: ⏱️ Switching logic
switching.content:
This option determines how long the application waits after detecting a stop before changing the activity.

Available values:

  • Immediately
  • 10 seconds
  • 30 seconds
  • 1 minute
  • 2 minutes
  • 5 minutes

For example, if 1 minute is selected and the vehicle moves again during that minute, the stop activity is cancelled and driving continues. With Immediately, the switch occurs as soon as a stop is detected.

defaultActivity.title: Default activity after stopping
defaultActivity.content:
This option determines which activity is saved after a stop is detected.

Available program activities include, for example:

  • Rest
  • Work

distinction.title: ⚠️ Important distinction
distinction.content:
Do not confuse these three separate concepts:

Detection operating mode

  • OFF
  • MANUAL
  • STANDBY
  • AUTO

Detection mode / sampling method

  • Disabled
  • High accuracy
  • Balanced
  • Battery saving
  • Custom

Vehicle recognition state

  • Outside the vehicle
  • Definitely outside the vehicle
  • In the vehicle
  • Definitely in the vehicle
  • In-Car Lock
